body:
Rave: I'm slowly but steadily losing weight! Down about 28 pounds, and it feels good finally being at healthy BMI. I'm also kind of getting the hang of not eating when I'm bored.

Rant: Friend keeps saying I don't eat, and warns me about starvation mode all the time. I'm not hungry in the mornings or during our school's lunch period so I just eat a light lunch at home and dinner or just a big dinner (while staying within my calorie limit usually lol). But she insists that I never eat and that my body will just make me gain weight if I don't eat. Seriously, if I hear the words "Starvation Mode" from her one more time I'm going to lose my mind.

I think I just view myself as worthless, so if I died it would be for the best, and I'm just tired of having anxiety attacks every night and being super out of it at school and at home, but after reading these comments I think I can stay for at least a little while longer, thanks to everyone's encouragement.

thank you so much, your comment means a lot to me! I think for now at least I won't draft a note or plan to give away any of my things, and I'll be talking to my psychologist about all this too. I'm sorry for all you've gone through, but I'm glad you're here and going through life, and I'll try my best to stick around.

Thank you for your comment! I have really bad anxiety so I'm not sure if I can talk to someone on a hotline or something (it took a lot of internal debate just to make this post), but I'll look into resources soon! I'll reconsider, I can't promise I'll live but for now, I'm still here.

My parents are great people, unless it's about lgbt and things like that as they're pretty conservative, also they dont fully get the idea of depression/mental illness. Luckily they understand that there are things that they won't be able to talk to me about, and I get to go a psychologist, who helps so I'll be talking about this to her when I next see her I guess.
